title: Motorcycle Cover 218×118 cm – Rain, Dust & UV
descriptionHtml:
The paint takes a beating every night your bike stays outside

Rain, bird droppings and sun work away at the bike around the clock. After a season outdoors it shows – dull paint, rust on the chrome.

A shell that takes the weather instead

The cover goes on in a minute and covers the whole bike, 218 × 118.5 cm. Rain runs off, dust stays on the outside and UV radiation bleaches the cover instead of the paint.

Features

  • Keeps rain and sun off the paint – water-repellent material with UV protection
  • On and off in a minute – lightweight material, no buckles to wrestle with
  • Stays put in wind – elastic hem around the bottom edge
  • Covers the whole bike – 218 × 118.5 cm, fits most motorcycles and e-bikes
  • Comes along on the trip – folds into a small bundle

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
